{{Quote|I've never seen colors like it.''"<br />"''They hatch and take flight for a day, and they die by the evening, a brief and glorious&hellip;''"<br />"''&hellip;They're amazing.|[[Darman Skirata|RC-1136]] and [[Etain Tur-Mukan]]|<ref name="RC:HC" />}}
'''Daywings''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Insect/Legends|insect]] found on<ref name="RC:HC" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]]. Notable for their extremely short lifespan, daywings [[Reproduction/Legends|hatched]] in the morning and died by the evening. The [[Color/Legends|ruby]]&ndash; and sapphire&ndash;colored insects were found on the [[Braan River]] and other small standing bodies of [[Water/Legends|water]] on Qiilura<ref name="RC:HC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]'', which includes the appearance of daywings, in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Daywings appeared in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact|Hard Contact]]'', the first novel in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' series written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="RC:HC" />
